The APK contains the unmodified DottedSongtiCircleRegular.otf from release/v_0_1/dotted_songti_v_0_1.zip, renamed aerial_dots.otf.
The editable OpenType font and upstream conversion scripts are included. The original upstream release process includes FontForge cleanup; a byte-identical regeneration from bitmap input is not claimed.
